panel.headline: C1 and C4 in vacuum only; C3 on test beds; C2 and C5 on a stellarator candidate open

summary: Organized by the stellarator contract (C1 current-free rotational transform, C2 omnigeneity for thermal ions and electrons, C3 finite-β stability, C4 existence, C5 thermal performance on the same candidate); non-axisymmetry is a consequence, not a goal. Status: C1 and C4 only in vacuum (an exact non-axisymmetric vacuum field with a KAM-certified torus, ι ≈ 0.137, confining field lines for all time); C2 essentially open for thermal particles (weak quasisymmetry defined, Landreman families proved not weakly quasisymmetric; passing 3.5 MeV alphas confined for all time in the vacuum field, Littlejohn model, one species); C3 only on test beds that fail C1 (Landreman family 2 carries positive net toroidal current) and on a Solov'ev tokamak model; C5 only on that tokamak model (one field with a pressure-budget band, transport solutions supplied) and in 0-D. First strict audit done; orbits proved to exist; Landreman family 1 proved a Grad counterexample (infrastructure); every module with a recorded peak is within the 6 GB laptop target after the split of the one 6.7 GB module.

tasks.model-contracts:I1: Partially implemented — algebraic force balance and tangency; positive permeability and actual differential laws in the restricted slab model.
tasks.model-contracts:I2: Lean verified — uniform-field and nonzero-current force-free witnesses in the Cartesian slab model; not toroidal confinement.
tasks.model-contracts:I3: Partially implemented — common-witness contracts and an assumption ledger; full decoded candidate identity remains pending.
tasks.model-contracts:I4: Partially implemented — interval containment, continuous clearance, and exact whole-box slab margin; text parsing and general signed multiplication remain pending.
tasks.model-contracts:I5: Partially implemented — conditional conservation and coercivity bounds for continuous symmetric forms on one normed space; no MHD PDE bridge.
tasks.geometry-and-fields:G1: Lean verified — field/current tangency and uniform-field witness; the analytic instance is Cartesian, not toroidal.
tasks.geometry-and-fields:G4: Partially implemented — Lipschitz-cover clearance at every parameter point; Fourier bounds, regularity, and embedding certificates remain pending.
tasks.plasma-models-and-equilibrium:E1: Lean verified — exact Solov'ev (a tokamak model), helical, validated slab, and Landreman families 1 (zero shear) and 2 (proved shear) finite-β non-axisymmetric equilibria satisfy the kernel ForceBalance law with actual Ampère current and a real pressure gradient (Design/ForceBalanceGradient); family 1 is a Grad counterexample (family1_grad_counterexample, infrastructure). Under the contract both Landreman families carry net toroidal current, so they fail C1.
tasks.mhd-stability:S1: Partially implemented — abstract energy conservation and norm bounds conditional on a differentiable solution; same-space variant only.
tasks.mhd-stability:S3: Partially implemented — scalar two-channel Young drive inequality; integral MHD identity and geometric coercivity remain pending.
tasks.mhd-stability:S4: Partially implemented — exact neutral-drift counterexample; the MHD quotient and admissible-space characterization remain pending.
tasks.particles-and-transport:K3: Partially implemented — 3.5 MeV alpha orbits in an exact Solov'ev field (a tokamak model) exist and are all confined for all time (reactor_alpha_born_confined); passing alpha guiding centres confined for all time in an exact vacuum stellarator field (Littlejohn model): μ = 0 over B₀R₀ ∈ [67.95, 69.99] T·m, every λ ∈ [0, 1/4] at one energy and B₀R₀ (on-demand), a ±0.4 eV × λ ∈ [0, 1/16] window (on-demand); near-QA passing alphas 0.19 s for orbits off the axis, with existence on the full horizon only for a band of births. One species, mostly passing: part of C2 at most; trapped alphas open.
tasks.verified-numerics:N1: Partially implemented — exact mantissa/scale decoding, interval containment, addition, negation, and nonnegative products; no text parser yet.
tasks.verified-numerics:N2: Partially implemented — continuous Lipschitz-cover clearance; Fourier and tail estimates remain pending.
tasks.verified-numerics:N3: Partially implemented — exact two-block checker plus a polynomial interval checker (kernel decide) proving Riccati/Jacobi certificates; proof-term certificate predicates (Kronecker, Boolean-checker, digit-sum and term-evaluation certificates, sound by induction) now replace most decide +kernel checks; matrix factorization pending.
tasks.verified-numerics:N4: Lean verified — local contraction existence/uniqueness, radii inequalities, and the injective equation bridge; operator-specific bounds are hypotheses.
tasks.verified-numerics:N5: Lean verified — nonlinear scalar x²=2 validation on [1,2], with residual 1/12 and Lipschitz constant 1/3; not a plasma PDE.
tasks.verified-numerics:N9: Partially implemented — common-witness composition and restriction of uncertainty sets; candidate decoding and physical feedback closure remain pending.
tasks.coils-and-design:D1: Partially implemented — filament integral, bounds, actual Fréchet derivative, and source-free Maxwell identities (∇·B=0 for any filament, ∇×B=0 for closed filaments) away from the source; higher derivatives pending.
tasks.coils-and-design:D2: Lean verified — exact circular-loop vector field on its axis and orientation reversal; the two-loop fixture has a positive midpoint field for positive equal currents.
tasks.coils-and-design:D3: Partially implemented — arbitrary 3-D placed circles preserve C¹ regularity, closure and simplicity; tube envelopes have continuous clearance/disjointness and manufacturing-margin transfer. Embedded winding packs and self-clearance remain pending.
tasks.coils-and-design:D5: Partially implemented — full-parameter position/tangent errors imply a C⁰ filament-field error; current errors compose with the same coils; a concrete polygonal coil set confines field lines for 52 transits (coil_stellarator_confined_concrete_N, field-line existence assumed); the coil-field KAM certificate is vacuous (Q-2); Cᵏ field-error bounds for k ≥ 1 pending.

tasks.geometry-and-fields:G9: Lean verified (vacuum model) — all-time field-line confinement in the exact rational stellarator field via a verified KAM theorem, with global existence and uniqueness of field lines proved (no remaining hypotheses); 0.077 ≤ ρ ≤ 0.19.
tasks.mhd-stability:S6: Partially implemented — Suydam both ways; Mercier certified for the reactor Solov'ev equilibrium (tokamak model) and on a band k ∈ [0.7, 0.9] of Landreman family 2 at λ = 200 (family2_mercier_stable_derived; Mercier formula supplied); helical equilibrium and family 1 proved Mercier-unstable. C3 status: family 2 carries net toroidal current (fails C1), so nothing yet for a current-free candidate.
tasks.mhd-stability:S7: Partially implemented — screw-pinch Newcomb stability for every mode m ≠ 0 (Newcomb's reduced form supplied; with radial balance, stable_all_modes_equilibrium); ideal ballooning of the reactor Solov'ev equilibrium (tokamak model) on every flux surface (reduction supplied); family-2 ballooning reduced to one pointwise certificate (numerically stable, not certified); no 3-D all-mode certificate.
tasks.particles-and-transport:K1: Lean verified — Newton–Lorentz energy and speed conservation, exact uniform-field gyration, Larmor-radius formula and realistic exact bounds.
tasks.particles-and-transport:K2: Partially implemented — Noether conservation of canonical momentum for any Killing symmetry (rotation, translation, helix) for full orbits; reduced Hamiltonian theory pending.
tasks.roadmap:P3: confined reduced orbits: Partially implemented — passing 3.5 MeV alpha guiding centres confined for all time in the exact vacuum stellarator field (Littlejohn model); full-orbit alphas in a Solov'ev tokamak model (orbits proved to exist); near-QA passing alphas 0.19 s off the axis. Contract: this gate feeds C2, which needs thermal ions and electrons (open).
tasks.roadmap:P4: finite-pressure equilibrium: Partially implemented — exact Solov'ev (tokamak model), helical and Landreman families 1 and 2 (finite β, non-axisymmetric, net toroidal current) satisfy the kernel law; contract C4 at finite β for a current-free equilibrium is open (Q-20).

tasks.implementation-plan:M2: Lean verified (idealized, tokamak model) — one field with a pressure-budget band on the actual Solov'ev flux geometry: driven, high-Q (Q≈40) and ignited versions; for every supplied classical transport solution (existence not proved) two-sided bands and pressure ≤ p_eq + offset (a budget, not equality).
